tested_law: On T2-O states, code(U)=b_G,r XOR XOR_{odd C} g_G,r(C), with exact current rank grading the component valuation.

findings.statement: Exact-rank-graded independent GF(2)^2 component valuation is consistent on six complete carriers: 3x3-k3, 3x4-k3, 4x3-k3, 4x4-k3, 3x5-k3 and fresh 3x6-k3.

4x4-k3 is the first direct Q/D tradeoff witness: the coarser Q-V carrier using rank mod 3 is scalar-exact but its phase-graded affine XOR evaluator has two contradictions; refining only the grade to exact rank removes both contradictions while retaining the same component parity and XOR model.
Exact rank does not make independent linear component valuation universal. 4x4-k4 retains 168 contradictions and 5x3-k3 retains 18 contradictions.
Relative to rank-mod-3-graded values, exact-rank grading reduces contradictions 4x4-k4 804->168, 4x4-k3 2->0, and 5x3-k3 45->18.

Because g_G,r(C) and b_G,r use disjoint variable blocks by exact rank, any remaining linear contradiction lies entirely within one exact-rank block. The surviving 4x4-k4 and 5x3-k3 failures therefore cannot be explained by a coarser global rank grade.

The six exact-rank positives prove finite existence of a rank-graded affine XOR coding only in those carriers; they do not provide a closed-form structural valuation and do not imply standard-7x6 qualification.

Before adding pairwise or polynomial interaction terms, recover an explicit same-exact-rank contradiction certificate from the smaller 5x3-k3 failure set. That certificate must determine whether the obstruction is a specific contextual component substitution or a broader nonlinear relation.

next_question: What exact same-rank dependency produces the 5x3-k3 contradictions under g_G,r(C), and what is the smallest rank-local structural distinction or interaction needed to resolve it?
